title: Command
description: A command palette: type to filter actions and pages, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to run. Command is the inline list; CommandDialog opens it over the page, usually on ⌘K (useHotkey). Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.
when: Jump anywhere and run any action from the keyboard (⌘K) in apps with many pages.
A searchable action list inside a Popover.

instead.need: Pick one value in a form
Filter the list on the page

a11y: The input is an ARIA combobox owning a listbox (aria-activedescendant), so focus stays in the input; groups are labelled; the dialog traps focus and Escape closes it.

examples.title: ⌘K palette
examples.description: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the button; try typing “don hang” without marks.
